capabilities: Render a folder of work-item Markdown files as a board or checklist from frontmatter
Create, claim, assign, and move cards between statuses via the plugin or wi commands
Run work-item commands through the Obsidian CLI or a standalone wi CLI for agents and scripts
Route cards to people for review using depends_on waits and approve by moving to done
Validate a vault with wi doctor and optional Git pre-commit hooks
extras: The README says the plugin is at an early stage and commands and behaviour can change between releases. It includes an install prompt meant to be pasted into a coding agent, and the Obsidian CLI path requires Obsidian installer 1.12.7 or later.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view and manage a hierarchy of work items spread across separate Markdown files as a status board.

relations.evidence: Recursive Board works with local vaults and with vaults that Obsidian Sync or another sync client synchronizes.

requires.name: Node.js 20.12+ (only for the standalone wi CLI on machines without Obsidian)

summary: Hierarchical work board that renders Markdown files with parent links and status frontmatter as Kanban columns or checklists, editable from files or a CLI.
